summary: Retested control tower APIs and authenticated browser flows. Serial backend regression passed 7/8; login, dashboard, scenarios, simulation, approval, inventory, admin, logout, and mobile overflow passed. Credentialed public OPTIONS still returns wildcard origin.

critical.issue: Public preflight from https://army-logistics-ai.preview.emergentagent.com returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * instead of the exact origin, failing credentialed CORS requirements.

integration_issues.issue: Initial login and logout passed, but a same-session second login did not reach the dashboard within 10 seconds during the follow-up run; investigate cookie/session re-login behavior.

action_items: Fix the deployed/public OPTIONS CORS layer to echo the requesting allowed origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials true, not wildcard.
Investigate why a second login after logout can fail to load dashboard data; verify cookie replacement and auth/me timing.
Run forced 503 browser checks for scenario and approval actions after the re-login flow is stable.
critical_code_review_comments: The application middleware emits explicit CORS headers, but the public proxy still rewrites preflight to wildcard; credentialed clients cannot safely use this response.
FAILED_LOGINS is process-memory state, so lockout tests contaminate subsequent browser login tests until the service restarts; production-grade rate limiting should be shared/persistent.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (core flows passed; re-login follow-up and forced failure flow incomplete)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created; used the configured synthetic admin and generated approval audit records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Serial backend suite passes except public credentialed CORS. Core browser workflow and mobile overflow pass. Re-run forced scenario/approval 503 toast tests and specifically verify login -> logout -> login.
rca of the issue: The application server's explicit_preflight middleware is correct when reached directly, but the public ingress/proxy responds to OPTIONS with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. The earlier lockout test also leaves FAILED_LOGINS populated for 15 minutes because it is in-memory; the service had to be restarted to isolate browser testing.
